text.tspan: As we use .replace-strict this maps the columns with correclty as mapped before [before we tried it with .to_list but the colums were encoded on first look first encode ], there is copy of data created in the CPU as the numpy is on C.P.U Which is breaking the GPU compatibility (will be worked when we implemen the second part of the issue that is array api)
